products.name: Gold Lust Repair & Restore Shampoo

products.name: Redken Shades EQ Gloss 06G St Tropez

products.name: Mecca To Save Face SPF 50 Superscreen Tinted

products.name: Dr.Jart+ Dermask Brightening Solution

products.name: The Quartet Multi-Peptide Ceramide Crème
products.purpose: Barrier repair and deep hydration. Ceramides reinforce the skin barrier, niacinamide calms redness and refines pores, hyaluronic acid provides multi-depth moisture, peptides support barrier integrity and collagen signalling. Doctor-designed Australian brand. Currently patch testing.
products.notes: Tester size (15ml). Ran out in 6 days at 3 pumps AM + PM. Cost analysis: $48/15ml = $3.20/ml, 50ml size $69 = $1.38/ml but still only ~20 days supply. INCI analysis showed peptides (Palmitoyl Oligopeptide + Palmitoyl Tetrapeptide-7 aka Matrixyl 3000) and ceramides are present at very low concentrations (bottom quarter of INCI list). Niacinamide was the strongest active by position (~4-5% estimated). Not cost effective vs The Ordinary alternatives which deliver higher concentrations of the same actives at roughly one tenth the price. Performed well as a post-laser recovery moisturiser (2-7 Apr 2026) but does not earn a permanent routine spot. Replaced by The Ordinary Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% (niacinamide gap) and The Ordinary Multi-Peptide + HA Serum (peptide gap).

products.name: Sensitive Hair Removal Cream
products.purpose: Depilatory cream for arm hair removal. Sensitive formula.

products.name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5
products.purpose: Multi-weight hyaluronic acid hydration serum. Layered on damp skin before moisturiser for deep and surface level hydration. Used as a standalone HA step underneath the Ilumaé Quartet crème during post-laser recovery and normal routine.
products.notes: Will not repurchase once finished. Ilumaé Quartet contains HA and will cover this step long term. Using up remaining product. Keep until empty, then let the Ilumaé handle HA duties solo.

products.name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1%
products.purpose: High concentration niacinamide (10%) for redness reduction, pore refinement, barrier support and sebum regulation. Zinc PCA controls oil and supports breakout prevention. Fills the niacinamide gap identified in routine audit (Apr 2026). Replaces The Quartet's niacinamide function at a fraction of the cost. Slot into AM routine after toner, before azelaic acid.
products.notes: 30ml for ~$9.50 (Priceline) or ~$7 (The Ordinary direct). Lasts 2-3 months at a few drops per use. Annual cost ~$38-57. Compatible with tretinoin (reduces irritation) and azelaic acid (complementary). 10% niacinamide is double the estimated concentration in The Quartet.

products.name: Multi-Peptide + HA Serum (Buffet)
products.purpose: Five peptide technologies (Matrixyl 3000, Matrixyl Synthe'6, SYN-AKE, Argirelox, Relistase) plus HA and amino acids. Fills the peptide gap identified in routine audit (Apr 2026). Supports collagen signalling, firmness and elasticity alongside tretinoin. Replaces The Quartet's peptide function with significantly more peptide diversity at a fraction of the cost.
products.notes: 30ml for ~$25-28 (Adore Beauty, Sephora). Lasts 2-3 months at a few drops per use. Annual cost ~$100-168. Recommended for PM use on non-tret nights as a peptide layer, or AM use. Do not introduce until post-laser recovery is fully complete and actives are back to normal rotation. Not urgent since tretinoin handles primary collagen stimulation.

products.name: Acidic Bonding Concentrate Conditioner
products.purpose: Post-colour bond repair and strengthening conditioner. Citric acid based formula that reinforces weakened bonds and smooths the cuticle. Used after every colour treatment for 2 to 3 minutes before cold rinsing.

products.name: Redken Shades EQ Gloss 06GB Toffee
products.purpose: Acidic demi permanent hair gloss used to tone and refresh colour. Mixed 1:1 with processing solution for home applications.

products.name: Redken Shades EQ Bonder Inside 07GB Butterscotch

products.name: Redken Shades EQ Gloss 06GB Toffee (replacement)
products.purpose: Acidic demi permanent hair gloss, level 6 gold beige reflect. Workhorse root shade for grey coverage. Mixed 1:1 with processing solution. 60mL tube.
products.notes: Replacement tube for the 06GB Toffee finished on 25 Apr 2026 (previous tube logged separately). Continues role as root and grey coverage shade in the new dimensional plan. Apply at root and through any zones with concentrated greys (temples, hairline).
